programmes.d: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programmes.d: Three bandits steal $200,000, but betrayal leaves the loot buried with a dying man. Glenn Hilton pursues the money, while the surviving thieves, a scheming banker, and the alluring Liz all try to claim a share. Greed, deceit, and double-crosses spark a chaotic hunt for the cash.

After losing everything in a poker game, Lucas takes a risky job delivering a wagon to Chamaco for $5000. But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

Framed for his brother’s murder by the Cris brothers, Gringo lands in prison with a friend. When the real killers escape and abduct Carmen, he must survive daring adventures to prove his innocence and rescue her.
Bank robbery pulled off by the bank officials, not the usual James gang.
José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.
A unique Euro-western with the hero as an astrologist who wears a leopard suit.

programmes.d: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail.
Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.
